messages:
anya (People Ops): Quick sync: we're publishing a reorganized Handbook Index tonight to make policy search easier and to surface the new compliance micro-modules. ETA: merged by 2026-07-10.

sam (People Ops): Why the index change? Is this purely UX or are we renaming sections?

anya (People Ops): Mostly UX: group by employee lifecycle (hire, active, transition). Also adding a short "What to do" checklist for managers on mandatory trainings and a visible expiration date for some policies.

lina (Benefits): Heads-up: we're updating the Benefits section language about part-time eligibility. Small wording tweak only, no retroactive changes. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/handbook/pulls/620

marco (Eng Manager): Can managers opt people out for reasonable cause? Example: extended leave during the window.

anya (People Ops): Yes — exceptions workflow stays. We'll add a new "temporary exception" checkbox and require a short justification. Sam will add the owner list.

jordan (HRIS): ops-bot, please create the nightly export path for the compliance tracker so I can ingest changes after merge.

ops-bot: Export scheduled: /internal/hr/exports/handbook_index_2026-07-11.csv next run 2026-07-11T02:15Z :robot_face:

sam (People Ops): Also adding a manager checklist card to the handbook index that lists (1) required training links, (2) how to mark contractor completions, (3) exception request form.

lina (Benefits): For contractors: confirm again they only need training completion to be compliant, not benefits enrollment.

anya (People Ops): Correct. Contractors complete the compliance modules. Benefits enrollment is per contract and covered by Hiring Ops. We'll add a one-line FAQ to clarify.

marco (Eng Manager): Can we get a weekly manager digest of missing completions after the index goes live? That will help teams keep track.

jordan (HRIS): I can produce a per-manager CSV starting 2026-07-12. Need manager_id mapping to be current.

anya (People Ops): Final note: we'll run a short comms wave tomorrow with links to the new index and a 2-min explainer. If you want a snippet for team channels, drop it here.

marco (Eng Manager): Please drop the snippet.

anya (People Ops): Snippet: "New Handbook Index is live — easier to find policies and manager checklists. Required compliance modules are listed with due dates. Review: <handbook link>. Questions? people-ops@redwood.com."

ops-bot: Reaction :white_check_mark: added by ops-bot
